ModMetaData.name: Arknights Endfield Armory
ModMetaData.author: Tamerlan08_1
ModMetaData.description:
This mod adds key Talos II mechanics to your game, from a high-tech arsenal to the dangerous secrets of Oripathy.
Weapons: Equip your settlers with futuristic swords and wedges designed to Endfield Industries standards.
Industrial Complex: Build your own automated factory to mine, refine ore, and mass-produce high-tech components.
Arts System: Master magical-technological abilities (Arts) that can turn the tide of any battle.
Oripathy: Face a dangerous crystal disease. It becomes a severe test of survival.
